publications.name: Bis-CF3-bipyridine Ligands for the Iridium-Catalyzed Borylation of N-Methylamides
publications.summary: 5-CF₃ bipyridine ligands boost Ir-catalyzed borylation of methylamides, enabling selective C–H activation at the methyl group through ligand–substrate dispersion interactions.

publications.name: Ruthenium-catalyzed intermolecular alkene-alkyne couplings in biologically relevant media
publications.summary: CpRu(II) complexes promote alkyne–alkene coupling in water and cell media, tolerating biomolecules and enabling peptide and amino acid labeling via bioorthogonal C–C bond formation.

publications.name: Iridium-Catalyzed ortho-Selective Borylation of Aromatic Amides Enabled by 5-Trifluoromethylated Bipyridine Ligands
publications.summary: A 5-CF₃ bipyridine ligand flips Ir-catalyzed borylation of aromatic amides from meta/para to ortho, driven by outer-sphere interactions between the ligand and the substrate’s amide.

publications.name: Practical, Large-Scale Preparation of Benzoxepines and Coumarins through Rhodium(III)-Catalyzed C-H Activation/Annulation Reactions
publications.summary: Rh-catalyzed couplings convert 2-alkenylphenols into benzoxepines or coumarins using alkynes or CO, with scalable conditions (up to 33 mmol) and low catalyst loadings.
